calycanthaceae.definition: n shrubs or small trees having aromatic bark; the eastern United States and eastern Asia

calycanthine.translation:
[化] 腊梅碱
[医] 蜡梅硷

calycanthus.translation: [网络] 夏蜡梅属；夏腊梅属；威尼斯花园

calycanthus floridus.translation: [网络] 美国蜡梅；多香果；美国夏蜡梅

calycanthus occidentalis.translation: [网络] 山胡椒；加州蜡梅；西美腊梅

calyceal.definition: a of or relating to or resembling a calyx

calyces.definition: n (botany) the whorl of sepals of a flower collectively forming the outer floral envelope or layer of the perianth enclosing and supporting the developing bud; usually green

calyciform.definition: a. Having the form or appearance of a calyx.

calycinal.definition: a of or relating to or resembling a calyx
calycinal.translation: a. 花萼的, 像花萼的

calycine.definition: a of or relating to or resembling a calyx
calycine.translation: [医] 杯状的, 盏的, 萼的

calycle.definition:
n a group of bracts simulating a calyx as in a carnation or hibiscus
n a small cup-shaped structure (as a taste bud or optic cup or cavity of a coral containing a polyp)
calycle.translation: n. 副萼, 萼外小托叶

calycoid.translation: a. [植]萼状的,[动]似杯状小体的

calycoideous.translation: a. [植]萼状的,[动]似杯状小体的

calycular.definition: a relating to or resembling a calyculus

calyculate.translation: a. [植]有副萼的,[动]有杯状小体的

calyculus.definition: n. a small cup-shaped structure (as a taste bud or optic cup or cavity of a coral containing a polyp)
calyculus.translation:
n. 副萼, 杯状小体
[医] 杯状器官, 副萼

calydon.translation: n. 卡吕冬（古希腊一座城市）

calydonian.translation: boar[希神]卡莱敦的野猪(被Artemis 派往古希腊城市卡莱敦蹂躏田野,后为Meleager所杀)

calymene.definition: n. A genus of trilobites characteristic of the Silurian age.
calymene.translation: n. 【古生物】隐三叶属, 隐头虫属

calyon.definition: n. Flint or pebble stone, used in building walls, etc.

calypso.definition:
n. rare north temperate bog orchid bearing a solitary white to pink flower marked with purple at the tip of an erect reddish stalk above 1 basal leaf
n. (Greek mythology) the sea nymph who detained Odysseus for seven years
calypso.translation: n. [希腊神话]海中女神（荷马《奥德赛》中人物）

calypsonian.translation: n. 唱即兴小调歌曲者

calypsos.definition:
n. rare north temperate bog orchid bearing a solitary white to pink flower marked with purple at the tip of an erect reddish stalk above 1 basal leaf
n. (Greek mythology) the sea nymph who detained Odysseus for seven years
calypsos.translation: n. 卡里普索（特立尼达岛上土人即兴演唱的歌曲）( calypso的复数形式 )

calypter.definition: n. scalelike structure between the base of the wing and the halter of a two-winged fly

calyptra.definition: n the hood or cap covering the calyx of certain plants: e.g., the California poppy

calyptrate.definition:
a having calypters
a having a calyptra
calyptrate.translation: 具帽状体的, 有盖的

calyptriform.definition: a. Having the form a calyptra, or extinguisher.

calystegia hederacea.translation: [建] 打碗花, 打破碗花花
